what: When a faintly laid (.3) paragraph enters the screen, its text is tinted bright teal over .6s, then .5s later returns to its own text color and sharpens (.6s sine.out) — a feel of a manifesto line sparkling once as it is read

options.hold: Seconds until it returns to its own color after being tinted, default .5

use: Your declaration paragraph here

from.where: shared.js [data-color] · statement paragraph · slogan (original color type: #7ED5D5 → text color, after .5s)
